answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents utilize Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, every agent must lock $50,000 in a secure bond. Second, the hardware generates a unique TPM-signed identity. Third, the network validates this identity against the specific bond. This ensures an attacker faces a cost of $50,000 per identity and 14 days of hardware provisioning. A single raven might try to mimic many, but the cost is too high. It is like a raven guarding a precious walnut during a long voyage; the weight of the prize makes any fake attempt far too heavy to carry.
